tas.title: Frontend Engineer
responsibilities: Developing new platform features with a focus on frontend
Creating new components following the company Design System, prioritizing performance, accessibility, unit tests, and Storybook documentation
Refactoring existing features to use new components, testing, and implementing accessibility improvements
Working primarily with Web Components using Lit and TypeScript

freelance.title: Frontend Engineer
responsibilities: Developed frontend for a pre-university course application with student management, activities, users, classes, activity models, and exams
Created landing pages focused on student acquisition with emphasis on performance, responsiveness, and conversion
Implemented UI using React.js, Ant Design for components, React Query for data fetching and caching, and React Hook Form for forms management
Documented components using Storybook and applied Domain-Driven Design architecture

bymycell.title: Software Engineer
responsibilities: Worked as a full stack developer at a biotech startup, developing features for a soil sample analysis results project using React.js, Tailwind CSS, and React Query
Developed the laboratory workflow administration system for analysis, working on both frontend (React.js) and backend (Express.js)
Refactored and migrated legacy backend to new projects with Domain-Driven Design architecture, resulting in more maintainable and testable code
Implemented unit and integration tests with Jest and Supertest, and maintained a legacy application developed with Svelte.js

take.title: Frontend Engineer
responsibilities: Key contributor to the frontend implementation of the company's backoffice system for managing orders, inventory, users, dashboards, and cooler telemetry using React.js, Material UI, Redux, and Clean Architecture
Maintained and fixed legacy frontend built with Angular
Actively participated in developing projects for international clients using React.js, Ant Design, Context API, React Hook Form, and React Query
Implemented end-to-end tests with Cypress, integrated monitoring tools like Microsoft Clarity, used SVG chart libraries like Recharts, and documented components with Storybook

suave.title: Full Stack Developer
responsibilities: Developed landing pages and implemented new features for client websites using Next.js
Built a social media link aggregator using Express.js, MySQL, and React.js
Performed SEO analysis and optimizations on client sites with a focus on performance and conversion rate improvements
